about_the_game:
In BE LOST, you will take on the role of three main characters trapped in a mysterious and terrifying world, where the boundary between reality and a sinister dimension begins to fade. Your journey begins at Jamjuree School — once full of life, now eerily silent, hiding dark secrets behind every door.

During your adventure, you will also step into the role of the SND Unit — a covert task force investigating supernatural phenomena across the globe. This time, they are drawn into a deadly mystery, forced to fight for survival while uncovering the truth behind hidden occult forces and forbidden knowledge.

From the abandoned school haunted by gruesome events to the pitch-black depths of Tham Lot Cave, every step reveals fragments of the truth while dragging you deeper into danger. Explore eerie landscapes and push through dense forests where sunlight barely touches the ground.

Key Features

  • Third-person horror experience with an intense and gripping storyline

  • Play as three distinct characters, each offering different perspectives and roles

  • Explore diverse locations, including schools, caves, forests, villages, and ruins

  • Face dangerous enemies with diverse tactics

  • Uncover mysteries and secrets through exploration and story progression

  • Manage resources and solve environmental puzzles that test both your mind and your courage

In BE LOST, your goal is not simply to find an exit — it’s to survive long enough to discover who is behind it all… and whether you can escape alive.

content_descriptors.notes:
Be Lost contains themes and depictions that may not be suitable for all audiences, including:

Fantasy and realistic violence — Combat involving melee and ranged weapons, blood effects, and depictions of injury.

Frightening and horror elements — Dark and unsettling environments, suspenseful encounters, and intense chase sequences.

Disturbing scenes — Dead bodies, references to death, and occasional mild profanity.

While Be Lost does not contain explicit sexual acts, it includes narrative themes that involve danger, fear, and emotional distress. Player discretion is advised.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster load times
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card with surround sound support
  • Additional Notes: SSD required, Headphones recommended for immersive experience
